'''Fusion shields''' were a piece of technology that were too dangerous to recycle. As such, fusion shields that needed to be thrown away in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Wicko District]] were taken to a [[Wicko District Garbage Pit|garbage pit]], sealed into canisters, and fired into [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="RP">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>
